info.description: Backend service for the Expense Reimbursement and Bill Management System (ERBM).
info.title: ERBM API

get.description: Lists visible Advances in THB. ADMIN and ACCOUNTING can read every Project; PM sees managed Projects and PC sees assigned Projects. DRAFT is visible only to its creator for every role. Visibility applies before pagination and total count. Sorted by created_at DESC, id DESC.

post.description: PC assigned to an ACTIVE Project creates a DRAFT with a required positive THB amount. Codes use ADV-{project_code}-{per-project sequence}, assigned once at creation. An existing ACTIVE Advance does not block DRAFT creation. Creation, code allocation and audit event commit together. Requester is the authenticated creator.

get.description: Returns the current Advance with the same fields and visibility as the list. ADMIN and ACCOUNTING can read every Project; PM and PC must be assigned to its Project. DRAFT is private to its creator for every role.

patch.description: Only the PC creator who is still assigned to the Project can edit purpose and/or amount. Omitted or null fields retain their values; at least one non-null field is required. Amount uses the positive decimal-string THB rules of creation. Only DRAFT or RETURNED_FOR_REVISION can be edited; the result is DRAFT. A closed Project cannot be changed. Update and before/after audit snapshots commit together.

post.description: Always returns the same result to avoid revealing whether an email has an invited account.

post.summary: Set an initial password from an activation link

post.description: Verifies an active user's credentials, returns an access token, and sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie.
post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Clears the refresh-token cookie. Tokens are not revoked server-side.
Validates the HttpOnly refresh cookie and returns a new access token.

get.description: Returns employees in a paginated standard response envelope. Requires the ADMIN role.

post.description: Creates employee profiles and invited login accounts for active employees. role_code is required and independent of the HR position. Requires the ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns a single employee by ID. Requires the ADMIN role.

patch.description: Partially updates an employee profile. Requires the ADMIN role.
Records an employee's employment end date and deactivates the associated login account. Requires the ADMIN role.

post.description: Replaces every outstanding activation link for an invited employee. Requires the ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns the current account, role, and linked employee profile.
Returns projects in a paginated standard response envelope. ADMIN and ACCOUNTING see every project; PM and PC only see projects they belong to.

post.description: Creates a project with a server-generated project_code: PRJ-{Gregorian year in Asia/Bangkok}-{number, minimum 6 digits}, starting at 000001 each year. Clients do not send project_code; a supplied value is ignored. A project has at most one PC. Optional pc_user_id accepts one positive user ID; the same PC may coordinate multiple projects. ADMIN and PC must send pm_user_id. A PM creator becomes its PM; a PC creator becomes its sole PC and cannot assign another PC at creation. budget is a decimal string such as "1000.00".

get.description: Returns a single project with its PM and an assigned pc object or null. PM and PC can only open projects they belong to.

patch.description: Partially updates a project. Omit pc_user_id to keep its PC, send a positive user ID to replace it, or null to remove it. ADMIN and the project's PM can edit fields and assignments; the assigned PC can only change name and description. Only the project's PM can close it by sending status "CLOSED". Closing returns 409 if any Advance in this Project is not CLOSED, including DRAFT. A closed project cannot be changed.

get.description: Returns roles available for employee provisioning. Requires the ADMIN role.
